Detailed body review transfers only after independent verification of byte-identical RGB bodies; current folios were viewed on final sheets. No source or PDF edits, new experiments, literature expansion or scientific tests.

carry_forward_proof.method: Compare every body RGB byte at108dpi across full page width and y0–700pt. Body layout ends above700pt; changing folios are separately validated. Only identical bodies qualify for inherited detailed visual review.
carry_forward_proof.independent_validation: Independently checked current PDF bytes, previous/final page PNG hashes, equal image dimensions and all RGB bytes across full page width from y=0 through 700 points. All 52 assigned page bodies are identical; no detailed page review is inferred for any changed body.

Table 2 distinguishes tasks/trajectories/rows and inferred/requested GPQA split. Corpus overlap and distinct denominators, domain-specific horizons, response protocol, minimum-step selection/action-space limits, grouping/calibration distinctions and source-version scope remain readable. Utility expressions preserve 0.05 per additional response and 0.0002 per completion token; 250 tokens correspond to 0.05. No clipping, overlap, orphan heading, detached relation, broken inline expression, incomplete table caption or unreadable identifier found in the reviewed ranges. Some proofs/prose continue normally across pages; equations and concluding statements remain intact. Final page folios are legible on contact sheets.

limitations: This is a bounded visual and semantic review of the assigned chapters. It does not establish empirical label validity across the full corpus, optimality of a fitted rule, institutional acceptance or a new scientific replication.
